reviews.title: Good program but needs work
reviews.text: I like the exercises and variety. They quickly became too easy for me so I added soup cans and eventually 5# weights.  There are a lot of parts of the app that are “sloppy”. For example, a workout module with 10 exercises in it might have the same exercises repeated twice (basic abs). Others work the right leg without working the left leg in a similar manner (wall Pilates). It makes me wonder if the developers actually use this program.  It’s also hard to know what to do once you have completed the 28 day program. It seems like you just have to restart the same program at the beginning when it feels like there should be different combinations with gradually increasing difficulty - but a few do have a “II” series.  It’s also hard to change the length of your workouts, you have to restart a whole program.  However, so far I have stuck with this about five days a week for seven months, so it must be doing something right.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text:
Follow everyday and you will feel better and get stronger. Enjoy

On second set of 28.  Love it!   The first set was great but I was ready for more movement and this set is perfect. I’m getting stronger and more flexible every day. Stay with it.  I haven’t lost weight but I’m increasing my energy, strength and abilities.  Thank you to the people behind the app. Enjoy.
On this 3rd or 4th set I decided to try two workouts a day which is good.  I’m moving in different ways.  One is on my bed but it’s not easy to maneuver on so I changed to the floor with thick mats. The other is walking and exercise in place which I don’t care for as it’s very slow and the music is not good for exercise. I just go faster and ignore, I mean it’s only 28 days. 
I really like that I can pick and choose different experiences with exercise.  
Keep going….stay focused and find your new healthy self.

reviews.title: Great work out
reviews.text:
Enjoy all different workouts. I have compared LazyFit to other online apps and these are the positive differences:

1) Lazy fit allows you to change timing between workouts

2) Lazy fit allows you to change the rest time 

The above two are very important since it allows you to get ready for the next exercise. With other online exercises, one exercise is standing, the following is lying down, and very little time is given to switch to the next exercise. 

3) Lazy fit has variety of exercises. They are all tailored to your needs, some other apps want you to pay for different exercises 

4) Lazy fit has a very calm and precise step by step instructions with soothing announcer voice. Easy to follow instructions

5) I have been a member for couple of years, first I did not follow and was very tired, but after I lost some weight I started to enjoy it more and more. I do Lazy fit, followed by my weight training three times a week

6) The price is right!

7) With LazyFit you do all exercises in privacy of your home….love it
